The Booty Movement

Strong. Sexy. Welcome to The Booty Movement

Aimee Fischer-Gray built The Booty Movement around a single, focused idea: strength training, glute-led, for women who want a real plan and a real coach. The site needed to do three things at once — sell three different programs, hold a members area, and feel like the coach behind it.

 

Three programs in one shop — Booty Prep, Booty Build and Booty Gains, plus the full bundle — each with its own page, image story and conversion logic. A three-minute find-your-fit quiz routes new visitors into the right program and the matching Klaviyo segment, doubling as a lead magnet. The High Protein Recipe Pack got its own opt-in funnel, a logged-in members hub holds every program and the training library, and a twelve-email newsletter program runs off the existing blog content.

Visit the site

WordPress · Stripe · Klaviyo

A find-your-fit quiz that turns cold scrollers into the right kind of buyer, a lead magnet that finally feeds the list it was always supposed to, and a newsletter cadence designed to slow down, not speed up — three emails a month, not three a week.

More? Sure Thing.
